final_text:
PROBLEM: D1 status: The fork reopened on 1 Sep, when C7 expired. Today is 19 Oct and the record still says quiet room, with no decision and no question to Odile. The Design section also only covers July and August, so it doesn't say where Rose residents are visited now. Before 1 Jul the choice was a silent designer default (garden room). Repeating that default after 1 Sep would make the same mistake twice.

PROBLEM: D1 options: The fork treats "where Rose residents are visited" as picking exactly one room. Outside July and August both the garden room and the quiet room survive C1, C2 and C7, and no constraint forces choosing only one. "Both rooms" is a missing option. The earlier "garden room" choice also left the quiet room out with no reason given.

PROBLEM: C1: Odile said Rose residents "shouldn't be brought into the lounge at all". C1 weakens this to "not visited in the lounge". The record should keep her wording, or say why the narrower version is enough for a visiting system.

PROBLEM: C2: The constraint is recorded as "no visits in Rose wing's shared rooms", but Odile's rule was "no visits in the rooms there", with all rooms being shared as her reason. As written, C2 would quietly allow visits in a Rose room that became single. Either record her rule as stated, or record the reason as a separate fact.

PROBLEM: D2 "Ruled out by": "web form only" has no ruling listed. It is ruled out by C6 together with Odile's 06-09 statement that landline families can still ring. Only "phone only" shows a reason.

PROBLEM: D4 status: The status says "review after July", but in October there is still no review recorded. The 45-minute, four-family default is still in force only because nobody revisited it. Odile's "looks good" was rightly not turned into a constraint, but the follow-up never happened.

PROBLEM: D4 scope: "Four families per room" is applied to every room, including residents' own rooms. In July and August it was also applied to the single quiet room that took all Rose visits. No constraint or choice was recorded for how capacity differs by room type.

PROBLEM: D5 status: The status says "open, asked Odile 06-16", but "What Odile said" has no 06-16 entry about outbreaks, and there has been no answer in four months. Meanwhile the Design section describes the outbreak button as settled. The record should either show her answer or mark the Design section as provisional.

PROBLEM: D5 vs C5: C5 requires that families *hear* of an outbreak the same day. Email and an unanswered recorded call only *send* a message. Nothing shows C5 is met, such as a check that each family received it or a fallback for those who didn't. The option that does meet C5, "office phones each booked family", is never ruled out or ranked.

PROBLEM: D5 "Ruled out by": C5 is cited against "email only", but email alone does not break C5. Only C6 does, because landline families get no email. Citing both blurs which constraint eliminated the option.

PROBLEM: D6 status and Design: The question about children has been open since 06-16 with no follow-up recorded. The statement that the summer impact "will be raised with her" has no record of being raised. It is now moot, because the garden room reopened on 1 Sep. The option list also leaves out "not allowed" and room restrictions other than the garden room. These options were invented by the designer, not given by Odile.

PROBLEM: Record as a whole: The record has not been updated since 06-23. Decisions with an expiry or review date (D1, D4) and questions awaiting answers (D5, D6) have passed their dates with no entry, so the record no longer describes the system as it currently runs.
